subject.title: fix: unify macos dashboard auth startup

question: Should the macOS embedded Dashboard browser receive native/operator device tokens via controlUiAutoAuthToken, or should browser injection be limited to configured shared token/password/browser auth?
rationale: This PR and the sibling shared-token-only PR implement opposite credential-boundary policies for the same Dashboard browser-auth path, and the safe choice depends on maintainer security/product intent rather than a mechanical code edit.

options.title: Resolve auth policy before merging
options.body: Pause merge of this PR and the sibling auth PR until a maintainer picks the browser credential boundary and updates or closes the losing direction.

options.title: Accept native-token parity
options.body: Allow the Dashboard browser fast path to use native/operator tokens, then close or reframe the shared-token-only sibling as not planned.

options.title: Require shared-token-only browser auth
options.body: Rework or close this PR in favor of the shared-token-only direction so native device tokens stay out of embedded browser injection.

recommendation.title: Resolve auth policy before merging
recommendation.body: Pause merge of this PR and the sibling auth PR until a maintainer picks the browser credential boundary and updates or closes the losing direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the native macOS Dashboard surface where this auth boundary lives.
